run.include_mlx_raw_note: Set true once mlx-lm ships gemma4_unified support (ml-explore/mlx-lm#1481) or once model.hf_repo points at an architecture mlx-lm already supports. False = A vs B only (Ollama GGUF vs Ollama MLX backend), both confirmed working on gemma4:12b in the dry run.
run.num_ctx_note: Sent as options.num_ctx on every Ollama request so the GGUF backend can't silently truncate a long prompt to a smaller default context window (this is what invalidated the 'long' bucket in the first full run). 24576 covers the default long bucket's measured ~13.2K prompt tokens plus max_new_tokens with headroom. If you raise prompts.long_words/long_tokens, or point this at a model with a much longer prompt, raise this too -- or delete this key entirely and run_matrix.py will derive one automatically from the largest configured bucket (see resolve_num_ctx() in run_matrix.py).
